# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-05-18 01:56 UTC — [Pillar 3] Recency gate blocks momentum promotion

**Task:** Follow P3 by checking live HL exposure, refreshing the BTC/ETH/SOL momentum scan, rescoring the paper momentum/pass-filter set, and testing whether the prior 60m promotion branch is strong enough to move toward live code.
**Finding:** Bots were alive (`58526.hl-bot`, `44849.pm-bot`). HL is flat with **37.391639 USDC**, no positions, and the live engine still correctly constrained by the notional floor: planned notional **$11.217492** vs **$20.00** minimum. Fresh `hl_momentum.py --dry-run --once` found **no BTC/ETH/SOL breakout signals**. The deduped paper set now has **399** pass/notional-blocked signals and **390** mature rows. Full-sample signed returns improved to 15m **48.7% WR / +2.25bp**, 30m **55.1% / +8.73bp**, and 60m **51.9% / +12.24bp**, but the last 48h are ugly: **28** mature 60m rows at **28.6% WR / -27.22bp avg / -21.10bp median**. The prior SOL-led idea weakened to **n=36 / 52.8% WR / +11.29bp**, below the required **60% WR / +12bp**. JTO remains tail-skewed (**43.1% WR**, negative median), and SUPER's improved full-set read is still too thin at **n=24** and conflicts with prior drawdown evidence. Artifact written to `research/p3-recency-gate-blocks-momentum-promotion-2026-05-18-0156.md`.
**My thinking:** The full-sample 60m branch is no longer dead, but the latest tape says the edge is not stable. Promoting a strategy when the most recent 48h are deeply negative would be overfitting an older sample. The correct P3 move is to formalize a recency gate, not loosen live execution.
**Decision:** No live HL trade, no leverage increase, no max-position increase, and no live-code promotion. Add a promotion requirement in research: candidate branches must clear both full-sample quality (**n>=50, 60m WR>=60%, avg>=+12bp**) and recency quality (**latest 48h or latest 30 mature rows WR>=55%, avg>0bp**) before live consideration. Account-size gate also remains active until planned notional clears the exchange floor without raising leverage or breaching risk limits.
**Next:** On the next P3 pass, turn this scoring into a reusable script that reports full-sample and recency gates by coin, side, local regime, market regime, plus pending unscored rows.
